key_concepts: Melting is a solid changing to liquid due to heat
Solidification is a liquid changing to solid due to cold
Vaporization is a liquid changing to gas
Condensation is a gas changing to liquid
Heterogeneous mixtures have visible or distinguishable components
Homogeneous mixtures have uniform appearance and indistinguishable components
Soluble materials dissolve completely in a liquid
Insoluble materials do not dissolve completely in a solvent
Some solids dissolve faster in hot water than in cold water
Some liquids like alcohol and water mix completely
Oil and water form a heterogeneous mixture
Air is a homogeneous mixture with uniform composition
